notes: Raindrop Plop! is a counting book built around accumulating raindrops and the sensory/emotional experience of a rainy day. The 11 fringe words cover the core concrete nouns (raindrop, puddle, boots, umbrella, cloud, rain, rainbow), the central action/concept (count, splash), a key descriptor (wet), and the emotional payoff (happy). 'coat' and 'mud' were considered but displaced in favour of 'rain' and 'count' which are more central to the book's structure. Several of these words (raindrop, puddle, boots, umbrella, splash, cloud, rainbow) already exist in activity_images or aac_extras per the existing data — mark those as reusable assets to avoid duplication.
